title: inventory endpoint misconfiguration
mechanism: A new order revision used an invalid inventory hostname, producing DNS failures while payment remained healthy.
impact_summary: Synthetic orders failed after payment approval because inventory could not be reached.
next_checks: Compare the configured inventory audience and hostname with the service URI.

action.title: Propose reverting the inventory endpoint configuration
action.description: Prepare an approval request for the last known-good order revision.
action.expected_effect: Restore inventory reservations for synthetic orders.
verification_steps: Verify order and inventory success after the proposed change.

expected_timeline.description: A revision with an invalid inventory hostname is deployed.

evidence.title: Inventory hostname changed
evidence.summary: The synthetic order revision changed the inventory endpoint hostname.

evidence.title: Inventory DNS resolution failed
evidence.summary: The synthetic inventory hostname could not be resolved.

evidence.title: Order failures rose while payment stayed healthy
evidence.summary: Order 5xx increased while payment authorization success remained normal.
